summary: Shops now show the total cost for the quantity you enter, the mouse view has a fresh new look, and Dark Mode got a color refresh. Happy hunting!

details.title: New
items: Better Shops: See the total gold cost and item costs for the quantity you enter
Better Mice: A redesigned mouse view, with your catches, crown, minlucks, and rewards up front
Better Item View: A tidier sidebar, with your quantity under the picture
Custom Menu: Hide and show the location HUD from the top menu
Better Maps: Collapse the found mice in the Goals tab and locations in the Sorted tab

details.title: Fixed and Updated
items: Dark Mode: Refreshed colors, with blue links in place of purple
Custom Menu: Opening pinned convertibles now shows the new journal entries
Better Maps: Toxic Spill maps sorted by pollution level
Better Marketplace: Click anywhere on a row in your listings and history to open the item
Location HUDs - Cerulean Skyport: Fixed large intel counts in the raid picker
